## Proposed change
Xiaomi Air Humidifier 2 (zhimi.humidifier.ca4) seems to be missing "auto" mode in it's speed list. This PR adds auto mode to list of available speeds.

I'm unsure how and if it should be amended in light of recent change to how fan speeds work by default.

## Type of change
<!--

## Additional information
<!--
  Details are important, and help maintainers processing your PR.
  Please be sure to fill out additional details, if applicable.
-->

- This PR is related to issue: #44292
The issue #44292 is about missing water_level attribute for zhimi.humidifier.ca4, but in the comments there is a code sample which includes support for "auto" speed. 
- Closes #50160

This speed level is mentioned by documentation [here](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/xiaomi_miio/#air-humidifier-ca-zhimihumidifierca4) but didn't actually work or appear in the interface.

### The problem

The humidifier cannot be switched to AUTO mode.

The service **fan.set_preset_mode** with the following data: **{"preset_mode": "auto"}** triggers an API error.

Note: in the project https://github.com/syssi/xiaomi_airpurifier the fan.py behaves correctly.


### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2021.5.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

core-2021.5.0

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

xiaomi_miio
